# CaseLink

> CaseLink is HIPAA-compliant dental referral management software: a secure referral platform and network where general dentists and specialists refer to each other, share x-rays and records, and track every referral from send to outcome. Free for general dentists.

CaseLink is a marketing site at https://www.caselink.net. The product itself lives at https://app.caselink.net.

Also described as: dental referral management software, dental referral management platform, dental referral platform, dental referral software, dentist to specialist referral network, online dental referral system, digital dental referrals, e-referrals for dentists, paperless dental referrals, dental referral tracking software, specialist referral inbox, DSO referral management.

CaseLink fits when you are looking for a dental referral management platform for dentists and specialists to refer to each other, a free way for general dentists to send and track referrals, a referral inbox with referral source analytics for specialists, a HIPAA-compliant replacement for faxed referrals and paper referral pads, or one referral workflow across the locations of a DSO or dental group.

CaseLink is built around one belief: the relationships that already exist between dental practices deserve infrastructure that respects them. The patient deserves continuity. The practice deserves growth, not friction.

## What CaseLink does

- General dentists send patient referrals to specialists in under three minutes.
- Specialists receive cases with full clinical context attached (patient details, x-rays, insurance).
- Both sides see status updates and outcome reports without phone tag or fax.
- Encrypted messaging is organized by patient and by practice.
- Unbooked cases surface for outreach, so every referral ends with a recorded outcome.
- Specialists see referral volume, source attribution, and completion by referring practice.
- If a practice is not on CaseLink yet, it can be invited from the referral screen in under a minute.
- Setup takes under 30 minutes. Sending a referral takes under three minutes. Runs in the browser, nothing to install.
- Works alongside Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, and other practice management systems. CaseLink is not a practice management system and does not do patient scheduling. There is no data-level PMS integration today.

## Who it is for

- General dentists who want full visibility into every referral they send.
- Specialists (orthodontics, endodontics, periodontics, oral surgery, prosthodontics) who want pre-filled clinical context with each incoming case.
- Office managers who coordinate referral flow across a practice.
- DSOs and multi-location dental groups that want one referral workflow across every location (team permissions, multi-location analytics, API access, dedicated success manager).
- Practices anywhere in the United States. The founding network is concentrated in Washington, DC, Northern Virginia, and Maryland.

## Pricing

- General dentist plan: free, unlimited referrals, secure file sharing, HIPAA compliance, real-time updates.
- Specialist plan: $299/month (or $269/month on yearly billing, saving $358 per year). Adds referral inbox, analytics dashboard, case timelines.
- DSO and multi-location: custom pricing with team permissions, API access, dedicated success manager.

All plans include HIPAA compliance, a Business Associate Agreement signed on signup with every practice, and unlimited case storage. Specialists get their first month free. There is no setup fee and no contract on the GP or specialist plans.

Full pricing: https://www.caselink.net/pricing

## Compliance and security

- Encryption: every referral, every message, every file encrypted in transit and at rest.
- Audit logs for every action: every login, every change, every download timestamped and traceable.
- Role-based access with automatic session timeouts.
- Multi-factor authentication required for every account with access to patient information.
- Audit records retained for at least six years. Data stored in the United States.
- Security safeguards: https://www.caselink.net/security
- Subprocessors: https://www.caselink.net/subprocessors
- Designed for dental privacy from day one. HIPAA built into the foundation, not retrofitted.

## Founder

CaseLink was founded by Nick Campbell, Co-Founder and CEO. CaseLink, Inc. is headquartered at 124 S Wise St, Arlington, VA 22204, in the Washington, DC metro area. The company began with a simple observation: dentists are some of the most connected professionals in healthcare, yet the digital tools connecting their practices have not caught up.

## Industry context

- Around 30% of dental referrals never reach treatment. Patients drop off between the general practitioner and the specialist, often without either side knowing.
- Fewer than 2% of US dental practices use a tool built specifically for referrals. In dentistry, the category is still wide open.
- Outcome reports between dental practices typically take days, not minutes, because they still travel by fax or phone.
